overview: Before light you opened the third act where the first act opened, in the street, at the hot end of the day. You wrote the line: for now these hot days, is the mad blood stirring. The talker is still talking, and still has a jest. You know he goes. You wrote that on this leaf you do not yet know the how.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote the opening, and left the how for later.

key_provisions.text: the how not on this leaf

assets.name: the street
assets.disposition: Wrote the mad blood line and left him jesting
